v.t: Now I say, That the heir, as long as he is a child, differeth nothing from a servant, though he be lord of all;

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But is under tutors and governors until the time appointed of the father.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Even so we, when we were children, were in bondage under the elements of the world:

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But when the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son, made of a woman, made under the law,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: To redeem them that were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of sons.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Wherefore thou art no more a servant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Howbeit then, when ye knew not God, ye did service unto them which by nature are no gods.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But now, after that ye have known God, or rather are known of God, how turn ye again to the weak and beggarly elements, whereunto ye desire again to be in bondage?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Ye observe days, and months, and times, and years.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: I am afraid of you, lest I have bestowed upon you labour in vain.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Brethren, I beseech you, be as I am; for I am as ye are: ye have not injured me at all.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Ye know how through infirmity of the flesh I preached the gospel unto you at the first.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: And my temptation which was in my flesh ye despised not, nor rejected; but received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Where is then the blessedness ye spake of? for I bear you record, that, if it had been possible, ye would have plucked out your own eyes, and have given them to me.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Am I therefore become your enemy, because I tell you the truth?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: They zealously affect you, but not well; yea, they would exclude you, that ye might affect them.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But it is good to be zealously affected always in a good thing, and not only when I am present with you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: My little children, of whom I travail in birth again until Christ be formed in you,

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: I desire to be present with you now, and to change my voice; for I stand in doubt of you.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Tell me, ye that desire to be under the law, do ye not hear the law?

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For it is written, that Abraham had two sons, the one by a bondmaid, the other by a freewoman.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But he who was of the bondwoman was born after the flesh; but he of the freewoman was by promise.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is Agar.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For this Agar is mount Sinai in Arabia, and answereth to Jerusalem which now is, and is in bondage with her children.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But Jerusalem which is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: For it is written, Rejoice, thou barren that bearest not; break forth and cry, thou that travailest not: for the desolate hath many more children than she which hath an husband.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).
tm.ot: Closely echoes Isa 54:1 (21 reader votes, OpenBible.info).

v.t: Now we, brethren, as Isaac was, are the children of promise.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: But as then he that was born after the flesh persecuted him that was born after the Spirit, even so it is now.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: Nevertheless what saith the scripture? Cast out the bondwoman and her son: for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with the son of the free woman.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).

v.t: So then, brethren, we are not children of the bondwoman, but of the free.

tm.apostle: Letter written by Paul, an apostle (Gal 1:1).
